data.headline: Product Sr Director, Health Tech Data - Digital Technologies
data.about:
Product Leader in Health/ Tech/ Data - building useful digital, tech product which doctors/ nurses love to use.

Certified Product Manager (CPM), and Agile Certified Product Manager (ACPM) through the Association of International Product Management and Marketing (AIPMM).
Certified Scrum Master with the Scrum Alliance.
SAFe Certified Product Manager with Scaled Agile Inc.

***Helps Healthcare technology businesses achieve optimal product market fit in the least time, using (wasting!) the least resources***

***Assesses, defines, launches and manages winning healthcare software, technology, mobile, or data products that meet market and user needs***

Specialties:
Product Management / Product Strategy / Product Innovation Management
Agile/Scrum/Scaled Agile
Voice of the customer, product owner
Accredited EFQM Excellence Assessor 
PRINCE2 Project Management
SaaS, Web/Mobile Apps, Cloud and Edge computing, Medical devices
Information System Analysis and Design
Business analysis
NHS Performance Audit and Improvement
Clinical Nursing Experience

Areas of Interest:
Healthcare Policy, Healthcare value (=quality/cost),  NPfIT/CfH legacy and lessons learned, Public Health, Population Screening, Patient Experience, Healthcare Informatics, Mental Health/ MHMDS, Primary Care, Healthcare Datasets, Data Standards, Interoperability, Information Governance/ Data Security, APIs,  SUS/HES, PbR, Benchmarking, NHS Commissioning, Telemedicine, HL7, SNOMED-CT, ICD-10, OPCS, Data Quality, BYOD, Business Analysis, Customer Service, UX / User Experience Design, CX /Customer Experience Journey Mapping

If you wish to connect on Linkedin:
barrykeown at gmail.com

description.text:
Everyone deserves a chance to explore and develop their potential.

Catherine Care offer a wide range of services for adults with learning difficulties to help them live life to the fullest.
• Day activities and opportunities
• Community access and participation
• Shared supported housing and independent living
• Residential care

CareCentric is fully interoperable, ITK-accredited and connects to most major health and social care systems being used in the UK.

Our mission is to make a lasting difference to quality of care by supporting the delivery of Integrated Digital Care Records to join up NHS and local authority care services for the benefit of patients, service users and citizens.

CareCentric is tried and tested and relied on by thousands of caregivers every day.

We helped established healthcare technology companies, national health agencies and digital healthcare start-ups to achieve optimal product market fit in the least time and the least resources. 

A unique combination of clinical nursing experience, empathy with nurses and doctors, as well as technical skills and commercial acumen.

Certified Product Managers/ Agile Certified Product Owners.   Proponents of the lean product management approach - test your assumptions, validate them, and pivot when needed. 
Experienced product leaders who have delivered and managed many successful healthcare products - those that have saved sight (diabetes retinal screening with Digital Healthcare), and help save lives (Dr Foster's Quality, Efficiency benchmarking and clinical audit tools). 

Healthcare deserves the smart use of available technology, user-centred design, and systems thinking to help improve quality, efficiency of care.   It's a sad fact that 70% of new product ideas fail, and this is even higher in start-ups!   Common reasons include: Wrong product, Ineffective marketing, Poor execution, Missed the market, Competitively weak, Rush to Failure.  These can be avoided with Product and Innovation Management.

* Established Healthcare IT Companies * Acute PAS/ EPR Systems Suppliers * Health and mHealth Tech startups * National Health, Social Care and Public Health Agencies

2010 to 2013:  Snr Product Manager/ Agile Product Owner for the suite of NHS Acute software products at Dr Foster, including RTM Real-Time Monitor, Quality Investigator, TrustView, Mortality Comparator, PPM Practice and Provider Monitor, COB Clinician Outcome Benchmarking

Listening, collaborating and influencing diverse stakeholders to drive forward improvements in software tools and services on behalf of staff and patients of NHS organisations, in response to customer need
2009 - 2010: Product Manager of Patient Experience Tracker(PET) and Mental Health Analytics and Benchmarking products and services

Responsible for assessment, design, launch, ongoing management and overall success of the entire suite of winning products in the field of Ophthalmology, Population Screening, Image Management Storage, and Image Processing.  Turned a pilot product that did not meet that needs of users into the market leading one.  Obtained ASCC shortlisting and US FDA and HIPAA approval. Over 3.2 million patients in the UK are now actively being cared for with the OptoMize product I managed and an automated care pathway I helped design and implement.


Management of all product lines to develop and publish:
o	Product and feature list
o	Product roadmap
o	Produced brochures, datasheets, user manuals, known issues list, product notices, and good practice guides
o	Initiated development programmes to improve the product and defend against risks and/or perceived market weaknesses
o	Product training to all clinical bodies
o	Champion and product expert internally and to the market place
o	Defined product mission, vision and values
o	Engaged users at industry events and User Group Meetings
o	Became the main point of contact with the national clinical body for all product related discussions
o	Responsible for competitive analysis, MRD, PRDs, Annual Product Strategies to meet the board and company business objectives. 

o	Represented the best interests of Digital Healthcare and screening services in general in interactions and meetings with customers of all levels, through professionalism, communication skills, insight, domain knowledge, reasoned argument, and repeatedly going the extra mile to get the job done and keep customers happy where at all possible.
o	Drove through a cultural change in delivering product, from customised product to ‘one size fits all with configuration’ product; one that is well tested, well supported, and which meets the core market requirements, and is responsive to changes via a roadmap.

•	Delivered a world first, in using HL7 v3 messaging to transfer clinical data from the high street to secondary care.
•	Produced the Solution Design document and process, almost entirely in my free time whilst delivering customer projects, and worked closely with Sales, Business Analysis, Operations and the Management Team to successfully introduce it.  This significantly enhanced Digital Healthcare’s capability in delivering the order book and supporting projects.
•	Resolver of over 800 Helpdesk Tickets, and contributor, commenter or technical advisor to a further 3000.
•	Software and Technical Product Trainer to all new Starters
•	Defined and implemented Hotfix Policy and chaired weekly Hotfix team meetings

Undertook performance management audits of health services with the aim of improving the economy, efficiency and operational effectiveness of services.  Applied my working knowledge of the NHS, researched key national and local drivers, and interviewed and engaged with key client executives / directors to identify, assess and address the operational risks.

I reverse engineered the working of an antiquated PAS system. I designed and implemented an Access/VBA version suitable for the needs of several high profile services including Assertive Outreach, Day Hospital and Crisis Resolution. It included qualitative psychiatric measuring tools and various reporting functions to aid service managers in staff and service-user monitoring / progress and for funding and research purposes. I also wrote the associated user guides and technical manuals and provided training to clinical staff.

Sales & Purchase Ledger, reconciling General Ledger with bank account, processing cheque & BACS payments, petty cash and using Accounting Systems and processes to produce monthly Management Accounts.  Assisted with specification of new company Database, prepared & presented financial rules & procedures for internal use, and acted as the office software support technician.

subComponents.text:
The ACPM credentials indicate a thorough understanding of basic and advanced strategic and tactical concepts in agile product management. It ensures that those who pass the exam fully understand agile product management and are able to apply the concepts immediately to be more effective in their jobs.

The ACPM credentials demonstrate skills in the areas of:
 Agile development (Scrum, XP, Lean)
 Release management and planning
 Documentation
 Organizing around Agile launches
 Roadmapping
 Distributed/larger teams
 Integrating agile within a traditional product process
